comparisons.peer_summary: The firm provides ongoing educational offerings, orientation programs for new hires emphasizing culture, and annual training events to instill its culture and accelerate integration, with senior employees receiving specific leadership guidance.
comparisons.comparison: BAC uses its Employee Engagement Survey to measure satisfaction and inform human capital strategies, citing an 84% index. GS emphasizes training and cultural integration programs to instill culture, noting that nearly all employees participate in at least one training event. GS does not disclose a specific employee engagement index score or survey participation rate, focusing instead on the mechanisms of cultural onboarding and leadership training rather than survey-based sentiment metrics.

sentences.text: The Survey results are reviewed by the Board and senior management and used to assist in reviewing the Corporation's human capital strategies, programs, initiatives, and practices.
In 2024, 87 percent of the Corporation's employees participated in the Survey, and our Employee Engagement Index, an overall measure of employee satisfaction with the Corporation, was 84 percent.
Instilling our culture in all employees is a continuous process, in which training plays an important part.

To accelerate their integration into the firm and our culture, new hires have the opportunity to receive training as soon as they start working via orientation programs that emphasize culture and networking, and nearly all employees participate in at least one training event each year.
For our more senior employees, we provide guidance and training on how to manage people and projects effectively, exhibit strong leadership and exemplify our culture.

comparisons.peer_summary: JPMorganChase relies on attracting, developing, and retaining talented employees in an inclusive work environment for long-term growth, with the provided information covering full-time and part-time employees while excluding contractors.
comparisons.comparison: While BAC provides specific quantitative results from its engagement survey (index score and turnover), JPM focuses on the strategic importance of its workforce and the scope of its reporting. BAC explicitly states that survey results are reviewed by the Board and senior management to review human capital strategies, whereas JPM states that long-term growth depends on attracting, developing, and retaining talented employees in an inclusive environment, without detailing specific survey participation or engagement scores in the provided text.

sentences.text: The Survey results are reviewed by the Board and senior management and used to assist in reviewing the Corporation's human capital strategies, programs, initiatives, and practices.
In 2024, 87 percent of the Corporation's employees participated in the Survey, and our Employee Engagement Index, an overall measure of employee satisfaction with the Corporation, was 84 percent.
JPMorganChase believes that its long-term growth and success depend on its ability to attract, develop and retain talented employees and foster an inclusive work environment.
The information provided below relates to JPMorganChase's full-time and part-time employees and does not include the Firm's contractors.

comparisons.peer_summary: The disclosed percentage for employee engagement is based on 2023 biennial survey results, reflecting responses from 89% of employees.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and MS disclose metrics derived from employee engagement surveys, but they differ in survey frequency and specific data points reported. BAC reports an annual survey with 87% participation and an 84% engagement index, along with an 8% turnover rate for 2024. In contrast, MS discloses that its reported percentage is based on a 2023 biennial survey with 89% participation, without providing a specific engagement index score or turnover rate for the 2024 fiscal year.

sentences.text: As part of our ongoing efforts to make the Corporation a great place to work, we conduct a confidential annual Employee Engagement Survey (Survey) and have done so for nearly two decades.
In 2024, 87 percent of the Corporation's employees participated in the Survey, and our Employee Engagement Index, an overall measure of employee satisfaction with the Corporation, was 84 percent.
Our turnover among employees was stable at 8 percent in both 2024 and 2023.
1.The percentage disclosed is based on the 2023 biennial employee engagement survey results, which reflect responses from 89% of employees.
